input.quote: ARTICLE XXII RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL During the term of this Agreement, the Licensor shall have the right (the "Right of First Refusal"), for a period (the "Exercise Period") expiring at 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on the fifth (5th) business day after the giving of written notice by the Licensee that it has received a bonafide offer from a third party to (ii) purchase all or substantially all of the assets of Licensee
input.rationale: No pricing MFN exists in the Agreement (Articles V-VIII are only the tiered per-trade fee table, and the Revisions clause at p0094 runs in our favour). Article XXII, however, imposes a most-favoured-offer/right-to-match mechanic on us: we must notify Licensor of any bona fide third-party offer for our assets or a merger and give Licensor five business days to take that offer. The playbook assesses right-to-match and most-favoured-offer mechanics under MFN, and this one fails every fallback element - it is not confined to a defined product, it runs for the whole term (36 months plus a possible seven-year renewal at Licensor's option), and it has no like-for-like comparison carve-out. We therefore take the preferred position: the operative grant is replaced with a one-line no-first-refusal/no-match statement, and the follow-on sentence is restated so it carries its own antecedent for the transaction and the third party and remains expressly subject to the retained Change Of Control (p0134) and Assignment (p0149) consent provisions, so nothing dangles or contradicts.

proposal.summary: Negate the Article XXII first-refusal/matching mechanic and restate the follow-on sentence with its own antecedent, subordinated to the retained Change of Control and Assignment sections.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We removed the Article XXII obligation to notify Licensor of third-party offers and let Licensor take them, as our playbook does not accept a most-favoured-offer or matching right in the Vendor's favour, and we restated the follow-on sentence so it carries its own antecedent and remains subject to the retained Change Of Control and Assignment sections.

ops.newText: ARTICLE XXII NO RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL The Licensor shall have no right of first refusal or right to match.
